response.overview: Fasha and Gunesh look like each other. They move like each other. Fasha is a father and is responsible for hundreds of sheep, Gunesh - the elder daughter takes care of twin lambs. Fasha is responsible for Gunesh as well. He gave her a name that means the sun. He now wants to give her most precious thing - independence too. Azeri ethnic minority in Georgia leads traditional nomadic way of life following sheep in mountains.
response.title: Hey, Gunesh!
